kind.description: decision: choose between approaches; approval: OK an irreversible or outward-facing action; question: information only the human has; action: something only the human can do (e.g. click an OAuth consent).

title.description: One line: the decision or action needed.

body.description: Markdown: the context, the trade-offs and what you recommend.

options.description: 2-4 suggested choices where there is one. The human can always answer with text instead.

id.description: A short lowercase slug (a-z, 0-9, -). Derived from the label when omitted.

label.description: What the human clicks, e.g. "Migrate behind a copy".

description.description: One line on what this option means or costs.

allow_free_text.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter; ignored. Every request allows a standalone text answer or an optional note with a selected choice.

blocking.description: Whether you are stopping until the answer arrives. Default true: end your turn after the call.

urgency.description: high only when waiting is costly (e.g. something is broken or a deadline is close).

dedupe_key.description: Your own stable key for this need. Asking again with it updates the open request in place.

expires_in_minutes.description: Close the request unanswered after this long.

id.description: The request id, as returned by request_human_input or list_my_human_requests.

reason.description: One short sentence on why it no longer needs the human, for example "User answered in chat", "Found the answer in the docs" or "No longer needed: the task was cancelled".
